incidents.summary: Rolls-Royce agreed to pay £671 million to resolve export-contract bribery allegations, and shareholders were considering a related compensation lawsuit in 2023.

sources.title: Rolls-Royce Holdings
sources.quote: In January 2017 Rolls-Royce came to an agreement with the SFO to pay £671 million under a deferred prosecution agreement to avoid prosecution for bribery to obtain export contracts.

sources.title: PRESS: Rolls-Royce investors eye corruption scandal compensation | Financial News
sources.quote: (Alliance News) - Rolls-Royce Holdings PLC may face a class action lawsuit worth GBP350 million from shareholders related to a corruption scandal from back in 2017, the Telegraph reported on Sunday.

incidents.summary: India filed a graft case against Rolls-Royce and BAE Systems.

sources.title: India files graft case against BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce | Reuters
sources.quote: India files graft case against BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce
